title: "EPM occupancy (manuscript)"
sample_data:
    - filename: DLC_single-mouse_EPM.predictions.h5
      with_video: true
---

A single-panel figure showing the occupancy heatmap of a mouse's centroid
across an elevated plus maze (EPM).

## Imports and style

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

from movement import sample_data
from movement.filtering import filter_by_confidence, rolling_filter
from movement.plots import plot_occupancy

from movement_figures import apply_style, figure_size, move_colorbar_to_divider, save_figure

apply_style("manuscript")
```

## Load and prepare data

We fetch the EPM sample dataset together with its still frame,
then apply a two-step cleaning pipeline:
a confidence filter followed by a rolling median filter.

```{python}
ds = sample_data.fetch_dataset(
    "DLC_single-mouse_EPM.predictions.h5", with_video=True
)
frame = plt.imread(ds.frame_path)
frame_h, frame_w = frame.shape[:2]

position_conf = filter_by_confidence(
    ds.position, ds.confidence, threshold=0.95
)
position_clean = rolling_filter(
    position_conf, window=5, statistic="median", min_periods=2
)
```

## Build the figure

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figure_size("single", height=4.0))
ax.imshow(frame, cmap="gray")

# Bins of 30x30 pixels, covering the whole frame.
BIN_PIX = 30
bins = [
    np.arange(0, frame_w + BIN_PIX, BIN_PIX),
    np.arange(0, frame_h + BIN_PIX, BIN_PIX),
]

_, ax, _ = plot_occupancy(
    da=position_clean,
    ax=ax,
    bins=bins,
    alpha=0.8,
    cmin=10,  # hide bins with fewer than 10 frames
    norm="log",
)
move_colorbar_to_divider(ax, "# frames")
ax.set_xlim(0, frame_w)
ax.set_ylim(frame_h, 0)
ax.set_title("Occupancy heatmap")
ax.axis("off")
```

## Save the figure

```{python}
fig_name = "epm_occupancy"
save_paths = save_figure(fig, fig_name, formats=("pdf", "svg"))
print(f"Saved '{fig_name}' figure to {save_paths[0].parent}.")
```
